hints.title: Maximize Number of Digits First
hints.text: A number with more digits is always larger than a number with fewer digits, regardless of digit values.

hints.title: Unbounded Knapsack for Max Digits
hints.text: Let dp[c] be the maximum number of digits that can be formed using cost exactly c.

hints.title: Greedy Reconstruction
hints.text: From d = 9 down to 1, if cost[d - 1] <= target and dp[target - cost[d - 1]] == dp[target] - 1, pick digit d.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: String concatenation at every DP state causes quadratic string copying overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing only integer digit lengths in the knapsack table and reconstructing greedily is O(target).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes more digits > fewer digits, solves unbounded knapsack for max length, then reconstructs.
complexity.notes: Returns "0" if target cannot be achieved.

solutions.approach: unbounded knapsack maximizing length and greedy reverse digit reconstruction
